name: Fairfax County, VA
findings: Fairfax County has 5,389 nonprofit organizations. 2,407 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 2,018 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Fairfax County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Research and think tank organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 206 research and think tank organizations here list membership, compared with about 53 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 206 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
